findings.title: align-items mixin emits invalid legacy-prefixed values
findings.body: The mixin passes the same `$alignment` to every vendor property. The old `-webkit-box-align` accepts `start`, `end`, `center`, `baseline` and `stretch`. `-ms-flex-align` accepts `start`, `end`, `center`, `baseline` and `stretch`. Neither accepts `flex-start` or `flex-end`, so those values would produce invalid declarations on older browsers. The bare `-ms-align-items` is not a real property. For the `center` and `baseline` values used in this PR the output is fine, but the mixin is unsafe for other values.

findings.title: Header children still use float inside the flex container
findings.body: `.contents` becomes a flex container, but the `.title` float rule was removed and `.panel` lost `float: right` in favour of `margin-left: auto`. Flex ordering is only partly applied: `.panel` gets `order(3)` and `.extra-info-wrapper` gets `order(2)`, but the title has no order. Its position depends on the DOM order matching the intended layout. The `.valign-helper` rule, which has `height: 100%`, is now a flex item and may stretch or shift. This layout change is not described in the PR.

findings.title: Floats inside the new flex container are ineffective
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex container, but its children (`.topic-avatar`, `.avatar`, `button`) still declare `float`, which has no effect on flex items. The trailing `clear: both` is also irrelevant for the container. The floated button therefore no longer right-aligns, and the layout may regress. The padding and margin changes also alter spacing for all small-action posts.

findings.title: Removed bullet margin-top may misalign badges
findings.body: The `.bullet` `margin-top: 5px` was removed from `.extra-info-wrapper .badge-wrapper`, and `line-height: 1.5` was added. This presumably relies on the header's flex centering, but other contexts using `.extra-info-wrapper` could shift vertically. `order(2)` only takes effect if the parent is a flex container.
